integration: Pinned native SDK with MapleSU source repairs, authorization transactions, runtime adapters and paired policy backend.

helperCredentialSnapshotRepair.replayBoundary: Original comm/config getters and execute_kernel_asm_func at 0xbdd00 are modeled. Candidate getter, PIE callback bridge, original synchronous generator/AsmJit/prologue/epilogue and emitted three-pointer comparison execute unchanged. Each final execution gets a new modeled credential; baseline per-byte reads receive 24 changing credentials.

requestContextRepair.credentialIsolation: raw capget/capset before every kernel request, including after fork

executorRestoreRepair.method: Restore full securebits in one no-result callback through its own reply slot; no cross-request cred pointer

authorizationRepair.bootRestoration: ProIdentityBroker after boot_completed with deployed repaired SDK
authorizationRepair.lifetime: Published arrays retained for boot lifetime; 16 MiB / 4096 reservation cap; unchanged refresh deduplicates

panicRepair.limitations: Only the identified before-hook path is synchronized; hardware cache/TLB behavior requires device acceptance

suExecutionRepair.behavior: Validate root-owned system helper directory and su; repair and read back mode 0755 and system_file context before grant or boot refresh

helperPanicRepair.limitations: Only the identified before-hook path is synchronized; hardware cache/TLB behavior requires device acceptance

previousPanicRepair.helperPatchKind: selective binary patch; not a full TU rebuild

authorizationRestorationRepair.behavior: Failed incomplete UID resolution preserves the whole live table; bounded root-only refresh retries; upgrade predeploys the current SDK boot-restorer.

upgradePublicationRepair.directorySyncFailureAfterRename: Returns ERR_MODULE_WRITE_FILE; replacement is already visible. Not a cross-file transaction or full rollback.

requestValidationRepair.replyScope: Legacy signed error and Android overflowgid=65534; nondefault overflowgid is not decoded

bootLifecycleRepair.completion: Commit checked one-byte success synchronously before publishing Running; no delayed child

environmentStateRepair.faultCondition: Current-boot duplicate receipt, safe_flag=3, enabled protection flag
environmentStateRepair.runningCondition: safe_flag=2 and a valid work receipt matching the current boot UUID
environmentStateRepair.unknownCondition: Startup/incomplete/read/root/IPC errors; no persistence mutation or capability grant

helperAllowlistRepair.causality: Helper initialization clears old control and retirement keys before this writer. This fixes its stale writer lifecycle coverage, but does not establish the current NX panic cause.

helperMemoryRangeRepair.scope: Protection range validation and page arithmetic; current NX panic causality remains unestablished.

moduleControl.semantics: Atomic desired boot state; installed-helper gate verified; legacy ABI retained; immediate stop unsupported.

baselineModuleControl.semantics: Atomic desired boot state; installed-helper gate verified; legacy ABI retained; immediate stop unsupported.
